proof_body:
by
  intro R S _ _ _ M _ P hP hd
  have hd' : Disjoint (M : Set R) (P : Set R) := Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun m hm hmP => hd m hm hmP
  refine ⟨IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint M S P hP hd', le_antisymm ?_ Ideal.le_comap_map⟩
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmx⟩ := (IsLocalization.algebraMap_mem_map_algebraMap_iff M S P x).mp hx
  exact (hP.mem_or_mem hmx).resolve_left (hd m hm)
target_source: ∀ (R S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (M : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization M S] (P : Ideal R), P.IsPrime → (∀ m ∈ M, m ∉ P) → (P.map (algebraMap R S)).IsPrime ∧ (P.map (algebraMap R S)).comap (algebraMap R S) = P
